query: Interim Valley Monitoring Site Direct Normal Irradiance forecast for 2022-10-16 that distinguishes persistence of the last observed level

evidence.claim: Maximum Direct Normal Irradiance on October 16 is forecast to remain below 60 W/m², even with clear skies.
evidence.exact_quote: Specifically for the 16th, predictive modeling suggests a significantly constrained solar environment. Maximum radiation levels are forecasted to remain below a threshold of 60 Watts per square meter (W/m²). It is critical to note that this upper limit of 60 W/m² applies even under clear-sky conditions, reflecting the severity of the intensity degradation observed at this monitoring site.

impacts.rationale: The site-specific numerical forecast covers the full future date and directly challenges simple persistence by imposing a below-60 W/m² maximum. Because it supplies a level ceiling rather than an additive or fractional change, no add or multiply adjustment is justified.
